lightbr.config.title: LightBR Config
lightbr.config.enabled.name: Enabled
lightbr.config.enabled.desc: Whether LightBR is enabled or not.
lightbr.config.chunk_xz_radius.name: Chunk XZ Radius (Horizontal Radius)
lightbr.config.chunk_xz_radius.desc: Horizontal chunk radius around track chunks to keep rendered. Higher values render more surrounding chunks.
lightbr.config.chunk_y_radius.name: Chunk Y Radius (Vertical Radius)
lightbr.config.chunk_y_radius.desc: Vertical section radius around track sections to keep rendered. Higher values render more sections above and below.
lightbr.config.render_water.name: Render Water
lightbr.config.render_water.desc: Whether all water should be rendered or not.
lightbr.config.render_lava.name: Render Lava
lightbr.config.render_lava.desc: Whether all lava should be rendered or not.
lightbr.config.render_group.name: Default Settings
lightbr.config.server_controlled.name: Server Control
lightbr.config.server_controlled.desc: When active, the server controls LightBR. Default settings apply only when the server does not acknowledge LightBR.
lightbr.log.disconnect_cleared: [LightBR] Disconnected from world. Track cache cleared.
lightbr.log.acknowledge_received: [LightBR] Server acknowledged LightBR. Server control is now active.
lightbr.log.obu_incompatible: [LightBR] WARNING: Incompatible OpenBoatUtils version. OBU integration will be disabled. Please update to at least OpenBoatUtils 0.5.0 to re-enable this.
